sources_considered.why: Primary evaluation of visual composition, with human comparisons and checks against benchmark artifacts.
Primary evidence of substantial contemporary progress in segmentation and transfer.
Read, but SugarCrepe provides a more useful assessment after addressing artifacts in earlier composition benchmarks.

evidence_items.locator: Section 5.3, evaluation of pretrained vision-language models
evidence_items.explanation: The evaluation of 17 pretrained CLIP models found substantial human–model gaps when captions swapped objects or attributes. Some object-replacement results approached human performance, but the broader composition weaknesses remained.

evidence_items.publisher: Kirillov et al., Meta AI Research, arXiv
evidence_items.explanation: Segment Anything demonstrated strong transfer on segmentation tasks, sometimes exceeding earlier supervised results. This qualifies any suggestion of little progress, but does not establish general visual understanding.

unresolved_gaps: The cited evaluations do not measure every branch of computer vision or assign a numerical distance from a complete solution.
